input.overview: Champ offers two scoring routes: lit captive-ball lanes and repeated trips to the upper saucer. Plunge the top saucer to light both captive lanes and bumpers. Test one square captive-ball hit; stay with it when the rebound and return are safe, otherwise shoot through the spinner to the 3,000-point saucer.
input.simpleOverview: In Champ, plunge the top saucer to light both captive-ball lanes and bumpers. Try one square captive-ball shot: if its rebound returns safely, repeat it for up to 4,000. If it rejects dangerously, send the ball through the spinner and back to the 3,000-point top saucer instead.
input.summary: Light both captive lanes from the top saucer or their adjacent mushroom bumpers. Compare a captive-ball rebound with the spinner-to-saucer feed, then repeat the safer profitable route. Bonus progress can light Extra Ball or Special targets.

quickInfo.summary: Scores 3,000 and lights both captive-ball lanes and mushroom bumpers.

quickInfo.name: Mushroom bumper
quickInfo.summary: Lights its adjacent captive-ball lane if the skill shot misses.

quickInfo.name: Lit captive-ball lane
quickInfo.summary: Scores 1,000 to 4,000 according to how far the captive ball travels.

quickInfo.name: Advance Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Eventually lights the Extra Ball and Special targets according to setup.

steps.text: Plunge the center top saucer to light both captive-ball lanes and their bumpers.
If the saucer misses, send the ball up top or hit each mushroom bumper to light its adjacent lane.
Make one square shot at a lit captive ball and watch both its award and rebound.
Repeat captive-ball shots when they return safely and regularly score near 4,000.
If captive-ball rebounds are dangerous, shoot through the spinner and return to the 3,000-point top saucer.

buildsToward.title: A repeatable lit captive-ball or upper-saucer route

steps.text: Light both captive lanes from the top saucer.
Test a square captive-ball hit and its return.
Commit to the captive ball or spinner-saucer route that is safer on this copy.

machineSetup: Confirm when Bonus lights Extra Ball and Special, whether those awards give balls or replays, and whether Double Bonus applies only on the last ball.
Test the top saucer, spinner feed, both captive balls and travel switches, both mushroom bumpers and lane lamps, Bonus unit, award targets, and every captive-ball rebound.
